sources.title: fernandotonon/QtMeshEditor-skintokens-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: All credit for the original weights goes to VAST-AI-Research. Exported for QtMeshEditor (issue #819), where it is the default skinner (qtmesh skin, the GUI "Compute Skin Weights" dialog, the rig→skin chain, and the compute_skin_weights MCP tool), running locally via ONNX Runtime with a geodesic-voxel fallback.
